'''''Galium spurium''''', the '''stickwilly'''<ref>{{cite book |editor1-last=Lee |editor1-first=Sangtae |editor2-last=Chang |editor2-first=Kae Sun |title=English Names for Korean Native Plants |year=2015 |publisher=[[Korea National Arboretum]] |location=Pocheon |isbn=978-89-97450-98-5 |page=475 |url=http://www.forest.go.kr/kna/special/download/English_Names_for_Korean_Native_Plants.pdf |accessdate=12 March 2019 |via=[[Korea Forest Service]]}}</ref> or '''false cleavers''', is a plant species of the [[Rubiaceae]]. It is widespread across Europe, Asia, Africa and Canada, and is naturalized in Australia.<ref name="peggyearnshaw">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=87547 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families] {{Archive url|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160130085509/http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=87547|date=2016-01-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Galium spurium [Caglio spurio] - Flora Italiana |url=http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=galium+spurium |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=luirig.altervista.org}}</ref><ref>Moss, E. H. 1983. Flora of Alberta (ed. 2) i–xii, 1–687. University of Toronto Press, Toronto.</ref> It is considered a noxious weed in many places.<ref>[http://www.invasive.org/publications/xsymposium/proceed/01pg117.pdf Wenming Zhang & K. L. Bailey. 2000. Biological Control of Cleavers (''Galium spurium'' and ''G. aparine'') with Pathogenic Fungi - Exploration and Discovery. Proceedings of the X International Symposium on Biological Control of Weeds 4-14 July 1999, Montana State University, Bozeman, Montana USA Neal R. Spencer (ed.). pp. 117-123 ]</ref>

''Galium spurium'' is an erect or reclining herb up to 50 cm tall. Stems are square in cross-section. Leaves are in [[Whorl (botany)|whorls]] of 6–8, narrowly lanceolate. Flowers are in multi-flowered [[Cyme (botany)|cymes]] or [[panicle]]s, white or yellow-green.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Galium spurium in Flora of China @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=250090777 |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=www.efloras.org |page=136}}</ref>

==Subspecies==
Many varietal and subspecific names have been proposed, but at present (May 2014) only 3 are recognized:<ref name="peggyearnshaw"/>

*''Galium spurium'' subsp. ''africanum'' <small>Verdc.</small> - mountains of tropical and southern Africa; also Saudi Arabia, Yemen, [[Socotra]]
*''Galium spurium'' subsp. ''ibicinum'' <small>(Boiss. & Hausskn.) Ehrend.</small> - Turkey, Iran, Iraq, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan
*''Galium spurium'' subsp. ''spurium'' - widespread
